title: A remark on diagnosability verification
summary: We point out three inaccuracies in paper [M.V. Moreira, T.C. Jesus, and J.C. Basilio. Polynomial time verification of decentralized diagnosability of discrete event systems. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 56(7):1679-1684, July 2011]. First, the authors wrongly claimed that their algorithm for verifying (co-)diagnosability of labeled finite-state automata (LFSAs) did not depend on assumptions. We give an LFSA that is not deadlock-free or divergence-free such that their algorithm cannot correctly verify its diagnosability. Because diagnosability is a special case of co-diagnosability,…
